question: On a Windows desktop, does adding OpenCU help an agent that already has a shell and full-screen screenshots over a remote-control connection?
engine: OpenCU 0.3.1 Windows (the 0.3.2 fix for synchronous modal dialogs came after two of the failures below)
machine: Windows 11 VM, restored from the same checkpoint for every trial; the agent reached it over wanctl

arms.A: shell commands on the VM and full-screen screenshots
arms.B: A plus OpenCU through wanctl act

metrics: median seconds per task and arm

scriptable.note: Both arms passed these mostly by scripting around the UI (Python-UNO, writing slide XML, obs-websocket). Two of the three B failures hit the 0.3.1 modal-dialog defect fixed in 0.3.2; one was a remote command that hung.

t01 change the default browser.note: state was correct early; both kept verifying until the limit

a_failures: A's UI-only failures: scripts driving dialogs that never returned over the remote connection, misreading uncommon characters in screenshots, and spending the whole run looking for a way around the UI.
limits: Two trials per cell, one VM, one model. The person-activity task (t09) is excluded: it tested a rule OpenCU does not implement between calls.
